parsed.study_design: Cross-sectional household survey with univariate analysis and multivariable ordinal logistic regression
parsed.population_and_sample: 538 adult villagers from households in a village in Northwest China; the village comprised 423 households and 1,686 residents
parsed.exposure: Participation in or receipt of 14 implementation factors within a government-supported UDDT promotional program, including trigger meetings, follow-up visits, commendation conferences, brand ambassadors, operation demonstrations, and on-site training
parsed.outcome: Household UDDT uptake and operational status, classified ordinally as good operation, poor operation, or no usage; household coverage reached 95.7%
parsed.rationale: The Methods describe a government–university promotional program and a survey of 538 villagers assessing 14 institutional and administrative implementation factors (pp. 790–792, Sections 2.1–2.5). The outcome directly measures sanitation access and sustained use through household UDDT installation and operation, while the Results report coverage and adjusted associations between implementation factors and operational status (pp. 792–793, Section 3 and Table 2).
